component.name: NeutronDrive
component.summary: An independent Linux client for Proton Drive

description.p: NeutronDrive provides a native Qt 6 interface to Proton Drive through its official SDK. Browse your cloud folders and transfer files using Proton's encryption and browser sign-in.

This is an independent community project, not an official Proton application. This alpha release needs a Proton account, a browser, and a running Secret Service such as GNOME Keyring or a compatible KWallet service.
Follow the system language with 25 offline interface catalogs and English fallback. Initial machine-assisted translations await full native-speaker review.
Native Rust backend processes, private state storage, job transactions and recursive inotify runtime; preserve Qt Quick UI and guarded synchronization.
Move daemon cloud-event routing and bounded pending-event decisions into Rust.
Automatic-only desktop synchronization and live system light/dark appearance.
Refined light Qt Quick interface and Rust remote-cache invalidation with conservative event handling.
Qt Quick/QML interface and native Rust decoding of local filesystem events.
Qt 6 desktop interface and native Rust validation and delivery planning for Drive events.
First Rust migration stage: native sync planning, baseline and daemon scheduling, with the existing GTK interface and guarded transfer adapters.
Automatic file deletion propagation with recoverable trash, baseline migration and delete/edit conflict protection. Whole-folder deletions remain protected conflicts.
Event-driven background synchronization and on-demand FUSE files with offline cache and recovery.
